question: How much does a knock-out trademark search cost per class?
reference_answer: IDR 750,000 per class, delivered within 1 working day.

question: How long is a trademark clearance opinion valid before the search must be refreshed?
reference_answer: 30 calendar days.

question: A client wants to check a logo, not just a word mark. Is there an extra charge?
reference_answer: Yes, a device (logo) search surcharge of IDR 1,000,000 per class on top of the comprehensive search.

question: What should the associate recommend if the search finds two or more high-risk conflicts?
reference_answer: Recommend re-branding or a co-existence strategy.

question: What is the minimum resolution for a trademark specimen?
reference_answer: JPG, minimum 1000 x 1000 pixels.

question: How much extra does an urgent same-day trademark filing cost?
reference_answer: An urgent surcharge of IDR 1,500,000 per application.

question: Do we give any discount when a client files in many classes at once?
reference_answer: 10% off professional fees from the third class onwards.

question: Within what period must a priority document be submitted after filing in Indonesia?
reference_answer: Within 3 months of the Indonesian filing date.

question: What is our professional fee for a standard trademark application?
reference_answer: IDR 3,500,000 per class, official fees charged separately.

question: How many days do we have to respond to a provisional refusal from the examiner?
reference_answer: 30 days from the date of the notice; draft ready 7 calendar days before the deadline.

question: The examiner rejected our client's mark. What arguments can we use in the reply?
reference_answer: Dissimilarity of marks or goods, co-existence evidence, letter of consent, or limiting the specification.

question: When are docketing reminders sent for an office action deadline?
reference_answer: 14, 7 and 3 days before the due date.

question: What status code is used when a trademark refusal becomes final?
reference_answer: TM-REF-FINAL.

question: How much do we charge to file a trademark opposition?
reference_answer: IDR 6,500,000 per opposition, excluding official fees and translation.

question: A competitor's similar mark was just published. By when do we need the client's go-ahead to object?
reference_answer: At least 10 working days before the end of the 2-month publication period.

question: What is the internal target for drafting a counter-statement when our client's application is opposed?
reference_answer: Within 10 working days of receiving the opposition copy; fee IDR 5,000,000.

question: Who must review an opposition brief before it is filed?
reference_answer: A partner.

question: How long does an Indonesian trademark registration last?
reference_answer: 10 years, renewable for the same period.

question: At which points before expiry do clients get renewal reminders?
reference_answer: 12 months, 6 months, 3 months and 1 month before expiry.

question: A client forgot to renew and the mark expired two months ago. Can we still save it, and what is our fee?
reference_answer: Yes, late renewal is possible within 6 months after expiry; professional fee IDR 3,500,000 per class.

question: What happens if the client never gives renewal instructions by the end of the grace period?
reference_answer: The matter is closed with status TM-LAPSED and a closing letter is sent.

question: What do we charge per designated country in a Madrid application?
reference_answer: IDR 750,000 per designated country, plus IDR 5,000,000 per international application.

question: For how many years does an international registration depend on the basic Indonesian mark?
reference_answer: 5 years from the international registration date (central attack).

question: A foreign law firm sends us a DJKI refusal for their client's international registration. How fast must we report?
reference_answer: Within 2 working days of receiving the DJKI notice, in English.

question: What is the PCT national phase entry deadline for Indonesia?
reference_answer: 31 months from the priority date.

question: How much do we charge per word to translate a patent specification?
reference_answer: IDR 350 per word.

question: The client sent PCT instructions two weeks before the deadline. Is there an extra charge?
reference_answer: Yes, instructions less than 1 month before the deadline incur an urgent surcharge of IDR 2,500,000.

question: How long is a simple patent protected?
reference_answer: 10 years from the filing date (a normal patent: 20 years).

question: When are patent annuity reminders sent?
reference_answer: 3 months, 1 month and 2 weeks before the due date.

question: Can we pay a patent annuity before the client's money arrives?
reference_answer: Only if the client has a standing credit arrangement approved by the Finance Manager.

question: What discount do large patent portfolios get on annuity handling?
reference_answer: 20% for clients with more than 50 patents.

question: Which views are required for an industrial design application?
reference_answer: Front, back, left, right, top, bottom and perspective.

question: Can an industrial design registration be renewed?
reference_answer: No, it lasts 10 years from filing and cannot be renewed.

question: What does it cost to add more designs to the same application?
reference_answer: IDR 1,000,000 for each additional design.

question: What is the fee for recording copyright in software?
reference_answer: IDR 2,500,000 per work.

question: What documents does a company need to record a copyright it owns?
reference_answer: Sample of the work, statement of ownership, deed of establishment and the assignment from the creator.

question: What is the format of a matter number?
reference_answer: LIP-YYYY-NNNNN, e.g. LIP-2026-00412.

question: Who decides when a conflict check finds a potential conflict?
reference_answer: The Managing Partner.

question: Can we start urgent work before the engagement letter is signed?
reference_answer: Yes for urgent deadline matters, but the engagement letter must be signed within 5 working days.

question: Do we need a wet-ink original Power of Attorney to file?
reference_answer: No, a scanned copy is accepted under firm policy.

question: How often are client due diligence documents refreshed?
reference_answer: Every 3 years for active clients.

question: What is the hourly rate of a senior associate?
reference_answer: IDR 2,200,000 per hour.

question: In what time units is billable time recorded?
reference_answer: 6-minute units (0.1 hour).

question: When do we need a written cost estimate before starting advisory work?
reference_answer: When the matter is expected to exceed IDR 25,000,000.

question: Which currency are foreign clients invoiced in?
reference_answer: USD, at the exchange rate on the invoice date.

question: What happens when an invoice is 90 days overdue?
reference_answer: New non-urgent work is put on hold with written notice; deadline-critical work continues unless a partner approves.

question: Who can approve writing off IDR 8,000,000?
reference_answer: The Managing Partner (partners can only approve up to IDR 5,000,000).

question: What are the standard payment terms?
reference_answer: 30 days from the invoice date.

question: Am I allowed to paste a client's unpublished patent into ChatGPT?
reference_answer: No, client confidential information must not go into public AI tools; only approved tools in the IT register.

question: Within how many hours must a suspected data breach be reported?
reference_answer: Within 24 hours to the Data Protection Officer.

question: How long are closed matter files kept?
reference_answer: 10 years after closure, then securely destroyed.

question: How should I name a draft response file?
reference_answer: MatterNumber_DocType_YYYYMMDD_vN, e.g. LIP-2026-00412_ResponseDraft_20260915_v2.

question: When must official DJKI documents be entered in the docketing system?
reference_answer: On the same working day they are received.

question: How quickly must we acknowledge a client email?
reference_answer: Within 4 working hours.

question: A client is unhappy with our service. What do I do?
reference_answer: Escalate to the responsible partner within 1 working day and log it in the Client Feedback Register.

question: How many days of annual leave do permanent staff get?
reference_answer: 14 working days per year.

question: How many days a week can I work from home?
reference_answer: Up to 2 days per week with team leader approval.

question: How long is the probation period for new staff?
reference_answer: 3 months.

question: How many training hours must fee earners complete each year?
reference_answer: At least 20 hours.

question: What does a cease-and-desist letter cost?
reference_answer: IDR 5,000,000 fixed fee; infringer given 14 days to respond.

question: Someone is selling fake products of our client on a marketplace. What do we charge to take them down?
reference_answer: IDR 400,000 per listing, minimum IDR 2,000,000 per batch.

reference_answer: Not in the knowledge base.
